newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-GOMARSALL HELPS ENGLAND TO VICTORY OVER ITALY.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-GOMARSALL HELPS ENGLAND TO VICTORY OVER ITALY.

text.p: Two tries from new cap Andy Gomarsall helped England to a comfortable 54-21 win over Italy at Twickenham on Saturday.
The scrum-half, one of five new players in the England team, scored the first of their seven tries in the 18th minute when he bustled over from close range.
England totally dominated the first period and were rewarded with further tries from wing Jon Sleightholme as they opened up a 28-0 lead at the interval.
The English continued the onslaught and lock Martin Johnson went over three minutes into the second half to make it 35-0.
The Italians came back well with tries from wing Paolo Vacari, scrum-half Alessandro Troncon and number eight Orazio Aracio.
England, though, were always in control and a second try from Gomarsall and two more in the dying minutes from the back-row men Tim Rodber and Chris Sheasby took them past the 50 points mark.
Fly-half Mike Catt kicked three penalties and five conversions for a personal tally of 19 points.
